content_text:
Thanks Tyler,
Yes, I would have to re-invest in some new lenses for the Nikon Z9. I wouldn’t want to use the MTZII adaptor in case I would lose image quality, so I’d rather start from scratch with new lenses. I’m leaning towards this model because I feel it would cover anything I would want to pursue in photography.
